source_text: Penalties were significantly strengthened, with the maximum term of imprisonment on indictment raised from five years under the 1985 Act to 14 years, signaling a heightened emphasis on deterrence given the procedure's severe, lifelong health consequences such as pain, infection, and complications in childbirth.
